# Synthetic worked-example term-list for `limensafe catalog build`.
#
# This is a CONTRACT REFERENCE for adopters, not real data. It uses the
# canonical synthetic vocabulary (acme / horizon / tilden). Real term-lists
# live OUTSIDE the repository tree (the two-layer catalog rule); never add
# real client names, codenames, or people here.
#
# Format: one mapping per line —
#     PROTECTED==>replacement
# Terms sharing a replacement collapse into one entity. Blank lines and
# lines beginning with '#' are ignored. A trailing " # class=.. severity=.."
# directive overrides the per-entity class/severity for that replacement
# group; put the directive on the first line of the group (or on every line
# of the group, consistently — a conflicting value is a line-numbered error).

# Client identity — two surface forms collapse into one entity.
AcmeCorp==>ClientAlpha   # class=client_identity severity=high
Acme==>ClientAlpha

# Project codename (uses the default class when no directive is given).
Horizon==>ProjectBeta

# Person — distinct replacement, distinct entity.
Tilden==>PersonGamma     # class=person severity=critical
